ratings_why.fun: Line order is a real puzzle every turn: who dies first, who inherits, and Cliff-Singer, Midwife and Rune-Carver chain off each other in ways the builds don't fully list.
ratings_why.distinct: A moving Lead title with Onward and Takes the lead is fresh, and any tribe can lead; the Pup-and-deathrattle layer under it is familiar.

verdict_why: Front Lemming's rotating lead clashes with the Lead rule as written, and that is the tribe's key multiplier.

points.text: The Lead keyword says in a fight it is your first living unit, but The Front Lemming moves it elsewhere. Say whether the lead stays rotated when a unit dies, and where it goes when the current Lead dies mid-lap.
Let Cliff-Singer's stat handoff count as Onward, so Brother Onward makes the sacrifice permanent. That ties the Cliff build into the Front instead of running beside it.
Snow-Hall Midwife putting Pups in F1 already makes every Pup take the lead, which fires Rune-Carver and Route-Map Reader each time; say so in the builds, since it is the best off-label line here.
Lemenår Herald halving on a loss pairs well with The One Who Arrived paying for deaths; a card that rewards the crash itself (a lost fight) would finish the boom-and-crash rhythm.

standouts.why: Killing your own Lead at Start of Combat fires Onward, passes the lead and moves the stats: one card touching every subsystem, plus Ooze bellies off-label.
Turns one Lead into a rotation, so Takes the lead and Banner-Bearer fire many times a fight; a true multiplier with a choice behind it.
Rewards stacking deaths in front of a late leader, so where you put your big unit matters.

weakest.why: Plain Start of Turn buff to other Lemmings; does the obvious job with no line-order hook.
A Pup a turn is fine economy but makes no decision beyond holding it.
Uncapped damage per death is strong but just counts deaths, with no use of the Lead.

flags.note: Rotating lead conflicts with the Lead keyword's first-living-unit rule.
No limit: Midwife, Ole and Nest Mother deaths at 4 damage each can clear a board before attacks matter.
With Midwife and Pups dying every fight, each Pup's Onward becomes permanent on the Lead; worth the owner's eye over a long game.
